newsitem.title: HONG KONG: OLS Group offers 120 mln shrs at HK$1.65 each.
newsitem.headline: OLS Group offers 120 mln shrs at HK$1.65 each.

text.p: Construction concern OLS Group Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 120 million new shares, or 30 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$1.65 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
The company said the issue price represented a prospective price to earnings multiple of 7.6 times on a fully-diluted basis, and 6.8 times on a weighted average basis.
The prospective dividend yield is 4.85 percent, and the adjusted net tangible asset value per share is HK$0.752, it said.
The IPO will run from June 17 to 20 with dealing in the shares to begin on June 26. Natwest Markets Corporate Finance Asia Ltd is the sponsor of the issue.
The company said the net proceeds of about HK$185 million will be used mainly to finance the initial capital required for new contracts recently awarded in Hong Kong, China and Malaysia.
The company said the proceeds would also be used as up front capital for the new operation in Malaysia, with the balance for prospective projects and additional working capital.
OLS forecast combined profit after tax but before extraordinaries of not less than HK$83 million for the year ending in December 1997.

OLS Group engages in specialist construction contracting in "alterations and additions" - the process of restructing, remodelling and refurbishing works done to existing buildings - and "fit-outs" - the process of finishing the interior or exterior of buildings.
OLS posted profit after tax of HK$68.74 million for the year ended in December 1996, HK$50.33 million in 1995 and HK$40.89 million in 1994.
The company had turnover of HK$509.92 million for the year ended December 1996, verus HK$393.84 million in 1995 and HK$421.47 in 1994.
OLS Group's parent company, OLS Asia Holdings Ltd, is listed on the Australian stock exchange, and the Frankfurt stock exchange.
